```{r setup, include=FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.2, dpi = 144, fig.align = "center")
R <- params$report
res <- R$res; cfg <- R$cfg; plots <- R$plots; ov <- res$overview
team_name <- cfg$team_name %||% R$team

p1 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", scales::percent(x, accuracy = 1))
e2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", sprintf("%+.2f", x))
n1 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "n/a", sprintf("%.1f", x))

tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, align = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(knitr::asis_output("<p class='na'>Not available for this data set.</p>"))
  knitr::kable(df, format = "html", caption = caption, align = align, escape = TRUE,
               table.attr = "class='scout'")
}
tx <- function(df, ...) if (nrow(df) == 0) df else dplyr::transmute(df, ...)
fl <- function(df, ...) if (nrow(df) == 0) df else dplyr::filter(df, ...)
fmt_date <- function(d) if (is.na(d) || is.infinite(d)) "-" else format(as.Date(d), "%b %d, %Y")
```

```{r team-colors, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf("<style>:root{--pass:%s;--run:%s;} h2{border-bottom-color:%s;} table.scout th{background:%s;} .kpi{border-top:4px solid %s;}</style>",
            cfg$color_pass, cfg$color_run, cfg$color_pass, cfg$color_pass, cfg$color_run))
```

```{r mock-banner, results="asis"}
if (isTRUE(cfg$mock_data)) {
  cat("<div class='mock-banner'><strong>MOCK DATA.</strong> This report was generated from simulated play-by-play built to test the pipeline. ",
      "Players, numbers and tendencies are illustrative and should not be read as real scouting of this team.</div>")
}
```

```{r source-banner, results="asis"}
if (identical(cfg$data_source, "nflverse")) {
  cat("<div class='source-banner'><strong>Public data.</strong> Built from nflverse (nflfastR play-by-play, NGS participation, FTN charting), mapped onto the PFF GamePBP layout. ",
      "Run concepts, PFF success codes, yards after contact and receiver alignment are not in this source; see <em>What nflverse cannot cover</em> at the end.</div>")
}
```

**Source:** `r R$source_file` &middot; Generated `r format(Sys.time(), "%b %d, %Y %H:%M")` &middot; Success = `r ifelse(cfg$primary_success == "std", "standard yardage definition", "PFF success flag")``r if (identical(cfg$data_source, "nflverse")) " &middot; EPA = nflfastR model" else ""`

## Key findings

```{r findings, results="asis"}
ins <- res$insights
for (cat_name in c("Tendency", "Strength", "Vulnerability")) {
  rows <- ins[ins$category == cat_name, ]
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) next
  label <- c(Tendency = "Tendencies", Strength = "Strengths", Vulnerability = "Vulnerabilities")[cat_name]
  cat(sprintf("<div class='find %s'><h3>%s</h3><ul>\n", tolower(cat_name), label))
  for (t in rows$finding) cat("<li>", htmltools::htmlEscape(t), "</li>\n")
  cat("</ul></div>\n")
}
```

<p class="note"><strong>n</strong> = the number of plays (or carries / targets) behind a number, i.e. the sample size. Findings are generated by fixed rules (see Methodology) and include sample sizes. Treat any rate built on fewer than `r cfg$min_n_group` plays as anecdotal.</p>

## 1. Personnel run/pass tendencies

```{r personnel, fig.height=5}
plots$personnel
```

```{r personnel-tbl}
res$personnel |>
  tx(Personnel = personnel, Plays = total_plays, `Snap %` = p1(share_of_snaps),
                   `Pass %` = p1(pass_rate), `Pass % 95% CI` = paste0(p1(pass_rate_lo), "-", p1(pass_rate_hi)),
                   `Run EPA` = e2(run_epa_per_play), `Pass EPA` = e2(pass_epa_per_play),
                   `Success` = p1(success_all)) |>
  tbl()
```

```{r pers-unknown, results="asis"}
n_unk <- sum(R$pbp$personnel == "Unknown")
if (n_unk > 0) cat(sprintf("<p class='note'>%d play%s with no recorded personnel %s left out of this section.</p>",
                           n_unk, ifelse(n_unk == 1, "", "s"), ifelse(n_unk == 1, "is", "are")))
```

```{r ctx}
res$pass_context |>
```

## Methodology and data notes

```{r steps}
tbl(attr(R$pbp, "sample_steps") |> dplyr::rename(Step = step, Plays = plays), caption = "How the sample was built")
```

```{r success-note}
success_note <- if (identical(cfg$data_source, "nflverse")) {
  "PFF success codes are not in nflverse, so only the standard rule is used."
} else {
  sprintf("**PFF success** maps `pff_OFFSUCCESS` codes %s to 1 and %s to 0; other codes are excluded. PFF does not publish these codes; the mapping (T/1G/2A = success, F/3R = failure) was inferred from the data and agrees with the standard rule on about 97%% of plays in a licensed PFF sample. PFF success rate on this sample: %s.",
          paste(cfg$pff_success_codes, collapse = "/"), paste(cfg$pff_failure_codes, collapse = "/"), p1(ov$success_rate_pff))
}
```

```{r nflverse-notes, results="asis"}
if (identical(cfg$data_source, "nflverse")) {
  cat("<h3>What nflverse cannot cover (or only approximates)</h3><ul class='issues'>")
  for (g in cfg$data_source_notes) cat("<li>", htmltools::htmlEscape(g), "</li>")
  cat("</ul><p class='note'>Column names below refer to the PFF GamePBP layout the nflverse data was mapped onto.</p>")
}
```

<div class="defs">

- **Pass play / dropback:** `pff_RUNPASS = "P"`, which includes sacks and QB scrambles. **Run:** `"R"`. Penalties and no-plays (`"X"`) are removed.
- **QB alignment:** Pistol if `pff_PISTOL` is set, otherwise Shotgun if `pff_SHOTGUN` is set, otherwise Under Center.
- **Success (standard):** gaining at least `r p1(cfg$std_success_share[["1"]])` of the distance on 1st down, `r p1(cfg$std_success_share[["2"]])` on 2nd, and `r p1(cfg$std_success_share[["3"]])` on 3rd/4th, or earning a first down. `r success_note`
- **First down:** `pff_FIRSTDOWNGAINED = 1` or yards gained &ge; distance.
- **EPA:** `pff_EXPECTEDPOINTSADDED` as provided. Passing EPA is attributed to the targeted receiver.
- **Target:** a pass play with a recorded receiver, excluding sacks and scrambles. **Receiving yards:** yards gained on completions.
- **Explosive:** runs of `r cfg$explosive_run`+ yards, passes of `r cfg$explosive_pass`+ yards.
- **Field zone:** `ABSOLUTEYARDLINE` is yards to the opponent's end zone (so 1&ndash;20 is the red zone).
- **Tell:** a pre-snap cue (personnel, alignment, down, distance, or combinations) with at least `r cfg$min_n_group` plays where one play type reaches `r p1(cfg$tell_threshold)`. The 95% lower bound uses a Wilson interval.
- **Intervals:** rates show 95% Wilson intervals; run-concept EPA shows &plusmn;1 standard error. With samples this small, most differences between groups are not statistically distinguishable; the report shows n everywhere so readers can judge.
- **Garbage time** excluded: `r cfg$exclude_garbage`. **2-minute drills** excluded: `r cfg$exclude_two_minute`. **Personnel "(*)"** marks a jumbo package (an extra offensive lineman replaces a skill player); merged into the base grouping: `r cfg$merge_personnel_tags`.

</div>
